RSI: A score measuring if an asset moved too far, too fast. >70 means Euphoria (high risk of a drop). <30 means Panic (high probability of a bounce).
MACD: Shows the momentum of a trend. A Bullish crossover means buyers have taken control. A Bearish crossover means sellers are overwhelming the market.
Trend: The AI's objective evaluation of the current price action versus its historical moving averages, telling you who is currently winning the tug-of-war.
SMA: The average price over a set number of days. These act as invisible magnets. When price falls to a major SMA, institutional computers automatically buy to defend that level (Support).
